caveats: Short interest is FINRA twice-monthly data — already ~1-4 weeks old when you see it. Borrow fees are IBKR-inventory snapshots. Insider selling alone predicts almost nothing; it only confirms.
13F put dollar figures are underlying NOTIONAL, not premium paid — a $912M put position can cost single-digit millions.
Crowded names (high SI + high days-to-cover) are gated OUT of the short book and listed on the squeeze watchlist instead: at extremes, high short interest marks squeeze risk, not opportunity.
Every short call is graded at 30/90 days NET of borrow-fee drag, with its worst adverse excursion published alongside.
